description: Resolve a memory conflict by keeping one memory and weakening or deleting the other.

forget.description: Delete the loser instead of weakening (default: false)

keep.description: ID of the memory to keep

reason.description: Reason recorded on the tombstone when rejectLoser is set (default: a conflict-context string)

rejectLoser.description: Tombstone the loser's value too, so it refuses re-ingestion (implies removal; default: false)

name: hippo_resolve
